transcript: I tried to visit a floating slum on toxic water run by gangs in Nigeria, but the most dangerous part wasn't what you'd expect. The main gang here is called the Area Boys, known for extortion, drug dealing, and theft. Before we even arrived at the slum, we were noticed by these guys who circled around our car and started banging on the glass. Eventually, we made it to the chief's house, who assigned us two policemen to escort us at all times, and we hopped on a private boat as we entered the slum. I stuck out like a sore thumb, and everyone was yelling oimbo at me. Which means in their local language, white boy. And one kid even threatened me. But then when I talked to the locals, I found out that they weren't as scary as I thought. People are friendly here. They're actually really cool people. And the biggest danger was beneath the boat. Oh man, I just saw the kid drink the water.
metadata_caption: They Told Me Not To Go Here (Africa’s Most Dangerous Slum)
